# Invest Coach

> A browser app for stock selection through investor-persona debate. Enter an investment amount, period, and risk tolerance, and multiple investor personas debate and present a conclusion. Runs in the browser.

## Tool

- [Invest Coach](https://invest-coach.miupa.jp/): Debate-style stock selection support app (Japanese UI). Free, no sign-up.

## About

- [MiUPa portfolio](https://miupa.jp/): Other free tools and Chrome extensions by the same developer.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/MiUPa/invest_coach)
